tex_content.label: eq:v4-event-factor
tex_content.html: \begin{equation} w(s)\leq (1+\eta )^2w(t)\quad (s-\delta <t<s),\qquad \delta =\min \{ \delta _0,s-s^-\} >0. \end{equation} The minimum puts every test time on the actual preterminal regular piece. The tolerance is chosen before the neighborhood.
